mentions.name: C programming book and video course
mentions.description: A planned book and video course teaching C programming, guiding learners from a basic printf hello-world program up to building a working web browser.
mentions.source_excerpt: I planned to create a book or video course about C programming, starting from printf("Hello world!\n") and ending up with a working browser; but the advent of AI coding agents in the past 2 years changed a lot the market for such a course.
